status: Measurement only. The owner replied "yes continue" to: edit Daniel's canon text to match his sheet, remake the sheet, and re-check all three styles (about $0.45), then pointed to the local dev OpenRouter key because the production key had reached its limit.
purpose: Daniel's four consistency-group verses in each public style after his canon text was edited to match his remade sheet, against the first re-check (sheet only, Classical and Watercolor) and the consistency verses (no sheet).
design: Repeats the first re-check after the canon edit; the edit changes Daniel's entry version, so sections that cast him get fresh looks, as production would make them. Each style family gets its own memory store, seeded from a fresh read-only production snapshot (which now holds Daniel's sheet) plus the section looks his earlier images were drawn with: the third launch matrix for Classical and Watercolor, the Fresco matrix for Fresco. A look is seeded only when its section and cast versions are unchanged. The stores run one after the other, because the engine shares in-flight preparations across a process. Each case is prepared once per store; every first image is checked and a faulty one gets one retry. Cases run three at a time.
scoring: Pairs per ADR 0008 with npm run evals:consistency over this run alone, so only the Daniel and lions' den groups are read. Two independent blind model scorers and operator settlement; the clarified scoring rule applies.
knownLimitation: One image per verse and style, with new plans and looks: a before-and-after on 18 pairs, not a controlled test. Runs on the local dev OpenRouter key, which shares the production account.
